# Startup Intelligence

> Startup Intelligence is an independent digital services initiative focused primarily on custom website design and development, with SEO and digital growth support plus separately scoped Meta Ads and Google Ads services. It is not represented as a registered company.

## Services
- Custom website planning, design and development
- Responsive interface and UX implementation
- Technical SEO foundations and useful content structure
- Meta Ads campaign setup and management
- Google Ads campaign setup and management

## Commercial details
- Website projects start from ₹5,000. Final quotes depend on scope and are confirmed in writing.
- Advertising management fees are separate from media spend paid to Meta or Google.
- No guaranteed search rankings, leads, sales or advertising returns are promised.
- Portfolio concept visuals are not represented as completed client projects.
